name: INIC Data Center / National Data Center (current facility)
notes: A-grade government Data Center/hosting service seed (official INIC service page lists Data Center, Backup, Pasta Partilhada, Alojamento & VPS, Gestao gov.st, Email Institucional, VPN, Rede e Infraestrutura, Administracao de Sistemas). INIC HQ: Rua Salustino da Graca, Edificio do Gabinete do Primeiro Ministro, Cidade de Sao Tome (Agua Grande). Capacity/tier/racks not public; exact server-room details not public. Facility located at sea level in Sao Tome with flood/disaster risk (per World Bank P177158 reporting).

name: New disaster-resilient National Data Center project (Grupo Erre / World Bank Digital STP P177158)
developer: Grupo Erre (consulting: site assessment + technical design); beneficiary INIC; funded by World Bank Digital STP Project (P177158, US$21M financing package)
notes: Mar 2025 (multiple reliable outlets: Executive Digest, Jornal Economico, DCD, oamarense.pt, e24.pt, pressnet.pt): Grupo Erre selected to lead creation of a new technology center described as the heart of STP digital infrastructure, storing vital public-administration data. Scope: site evaluation for a disaster-resilient Data Center plus disaster transition/recovery plan, because the current NDC at sea level faces flooding and natural-disaster risk. World Bank P177158 mission report confirms the contracted consultant completed the physical assessment of the existing government data center and presented options: (i) requalification/upgrade of the current data center (~EUR 0.5M) or (ii) new build - site not yet selected; capacity/status unconfirmed. Would upgrade to A with an INIC/official procurement record naming the site.

name: ACE / STP Cabo submarine cable landing station (Sao Tome)
developer: STP Cabo (PPP/SPV; CST holds 74.5%) / ACE consortium
notes: Connectivity record - NOT a datacenter. ACE cable RFS Dec 2012 with Sao Tome and Principe as landing station (ACE official page; Wikipedia; geocables); STP Cabo manages the landing station and national capacity share; STP switched from satellite to ACE in 2012 (World Bank P177158). Landing station in Sao Tome (Agua Grande). No colocation/hosting/server evidence at the station, so no DC facility record per methodology.

name: CST core network room / NOC (lead)
notes: Telecom core-network facility lead per methodology - NOT a confirmed datacenter. Incumbent operator CST launched national 4G (Aug 2023) and holds 74.5% of STP Cabo (ACE). No public hosting/colocation/data-center service page found this round; upgrade only if a CST/AGER official file names a data-center/colo service at a named site.

name: Unitel STP switching center (Centro de Comutacao) (lead)
notes: Telecom switching-center facility lead per methodology (technical launch incl. Centro de Comutacao; first 4G launch May 2023 per DCD) - NOT a confirmed datacenter. No hosting/colocation evidence; upgrade only with Unitel/AGER official confirmation of a data-center service.

name: Santo Antonio telecom PoP / inter-island connectivity endpoint (lead)
developer: CST / Unitel STP; World Bank Digital STP P177158 (inter-island connectivity planning)
notes: Telecom PoP/edge lead - NOT a confirmed datacenter. Principe depends on two microwave links; World Bank P177158 plans/evaluates an inter-island submarine cable (potential PPP, operated via STP Cabo or similar). No public DC in Santo Antonio; only connectivity/edge lead per methodology.
